boundary.title: Data and model:
boundary.text: All selected Primes share one Aya wallet. In each simulated Void Fissure Mission, you claim one reward from the squad's opened Void Relics; after each reward, the next Void Relic is chosen from the remaining missing parts. Recommendations are a heuristic based on missing parts, Relic coverage, and reward rarity, not a global optimum. Unlisted Forma and non-target rewards are represented by the remaining probability; existing Relic inventory, trading, and recruitment time are not modeled.
